0022600163.text: The 76ers (6-1) are 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East, with a three-game winning streak, a 3-1 home record, and a 6-1 record over their last ten, while the Bulls (1-5) have lost four straight, are 0-2 at home, and sit 13th in the East and 4 games back in the Central. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James are listed as day-to-day, with Embiid a game-time decision; Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), and Dailyn Swain (back), Jalen Smith (finger), and Tobe Awaka (ankle) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the 76ers lost the season series 1-2, though Philadelphia's most recent meeting was a 157-137 home win on March 25, 2026.
